slides.teacher_cue: New sound — and our first vowel team. Two letters, one long vowel sound: /eɪ/. Two spellings: ai appears in the middle of a word (rain, sail), ay appears at the end of a word (day, play). Same sound — different position rule.
slides.expected_response: Students produce /eɪ/ cleanly and understand the ai/ay position rule.
slides.correction_move: Model the position rule: ai in the middle — rain, sail, tail. ay at the end — day, say, way. Students sort words by position.
slides.observation_note: Watch for students confusing ai and ay spellings. Reinforce the position rule at every opportunity.

slides.slide_title: Say ai and ay In Words
slides.teacher_cue: Say the new focus, then connect ai and ay to one strong word from today.
slides.expected_response: Students say ai and ay clearly and connect it to a lesson word.
slides.correction_move: Model the focus once, then have students echo and use it in a known word.
slides.observation_note: Listen for whether students can carry the focus from isolation into a real word.

slides.teacher_cue: Sight word — underlined. Say it as a whole unit. Uses 'ey' spelling for /eɪ/ — ey is a variant of ay not yet formally taught. Learn as a whole unit.
slides.expected_response: Students say they immediately as a whole unit.
slides.correction_move: Model they in a sentence, point to the underline, repeat chorally.
slides.observation_note: Watch for blending attempts. Redirect — sight word, say it whole.

slides.teacher_cue: Say rain — water falling from clouds. Confirm /r/ onset and /eɪ/ vowel team. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say rain orally, connect meaning, then blend on the card.
slides.correction_move: Model rain orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /l/ on /r/ and for the ai spelling in the middle of the word.

slides.teacher_cue: Say sail — to travel on water. ai in the middle. Reveal and blend.

slides.correction_move: Model sail orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for the ai vowel team and /l/ vs /r/ in the coda.

slides.teacher_cue: Say train — a vehicle on rails. Note tr onset. Confirm ai vowel team. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say train orally, connect meaning, then blend on the card.
slides.correction_move: Model train orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for vowel insertion between t and r and for the ai spelling.

slides.teacher_cue: Say day — a period of time. ay at the end. Reveal and blend.

slides.observation_note: Watch for the ay spelling at the end of the word — contrast with ai in the middle.
